messages:
ania: Heads-up — APAC preemptible pool experienced a big churn starting ~02:10 UTC. We're seeing ~30% increase in eviction rate and tail latency on small-chat models. Logs saved to /logs/preemptible/1835.

matt: I saw the provider maintenance notice. Lots of spot terminations in ap-northeast-1. Autoscaler thrash is amplifying restarts.

raj: oncall — confirmed. Autoscaler hit cooldown twice; some jobs tried to spin up and got evicted immediately. Backfill from dedicated helped but not for all routes.

emily: Impact summary: free/dev workloads q95 latency up ~220ms, model_load_errors spiked due to KV cold starts. Enterprise customers stayed on dedicated and were largely unaffected.

jess: What's our immediate mitigation? Can we triage by tier and flip dev/free to fallback variants to reduce memory/startup?

matt: Short plan: 1) enable region failover to us-east for non-data-residency customers, 2) route free/dev to int8-quantized fallback variants with smaller memory footprint, 3) reserve a safety pool (20%) of preemptible capacity that isn't auto-evicted for active tasks, 4) bump mixed.pool min replicas.

ania: Can you paste the routing snippet we can push as a canary?

matt: Sure — pushing a minimal routing config (canary 5%):

```yaml
routing:
  fallback_policy:
    preemptible_churn:
      - match: customer_tier: enterprise
        route: dedicated.apac.pool
      - match: customer_tier: paid
        route: mixed.pool
      - match: customer_tier: free
        route: fallback_variant.int8
  region_failover:
    apac:
      fallback_region: us-east
      allow_data_move: false
      allow_non_residency: true
```

raj: Add these two small changes before rollout: set `kv_cache_replicas: 1` on the fallback_variant to reduce cold starts, and a circuit breaker on model load (threshold: 10s) to avoid cascading queueing.

emily: Also increase autoscaler min_replicas for mixed.pool from 2 -> 4 for the churn window so we don't have too many cold startups. We'll revert after 3 hours.

jess: Pushing canary now for free-tier -> fallback_variant.int8 at 5%. infra-bot: kickoff.

infra-bot: deploy 1835004321-config-rollout to env=apac initiated by jess. status: canary 5%.

matt: Monitoring knobs: watch q95 latency, model_load_errors, token throughput. Trigger alerts if q95 > 200ms or model_load_errors > 5/min or model_load_latency > 10s.

ania: Also add an ops alert to #ops and page if enterprise error rate > 1% (we can't tolerate enterprise regressions).

raj: We'll collect postmortem data tomorrow: eviction counts, cost delta from reserved safety pool, and autoscaler churn overhead. Need numbers to justify any shift in preemptible strategy.

jess: Thanks — keeping this thread as the runbook for the canary and follow-up. Will update when infra-bot reports success/failure. :thumbsup:
